generate_illustrated_image.title: Illustrations and anime
generate_illustrated_image.description: Use this tool for anything drawn, painted, illustrated or anime-style, whatever the subject. For photographs and photorealistic images, use generate_realistic_image instead.

generate_realistic_image.title: Realistic images
generate_realistic_image.description: Use this tool only for photographs and photorealistic images. For anything drawn, painted, illustrated or anime-style (even an illustration of a real-world subject), use generate_illustrated_image instead.
generate_realistic_image.default_guide:
This tool generates realistic/general-purpose images via ComfyUI.
Use natural language to describe the image you want. Be specific about composition, lighting, style, and subject.

Examples:
- A photorealistic portrait of an elderly man with weathered skin, dramatic side lighting
- A cozy coffee shop interior with warm morning light streaming through windows, watercolor style
- A futuristic cityscape at sunset with flying vehicles, cinematic wide shot

Note: The first generation after launching ComfyUI may take 1-2 minutes while the model loads into GPU memory. If the request times out, please retry.
